newsitem.title: USA: Seitel expects to post record Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Seitel expects to post record Q2 results.

text.p: Seitel Inc said Thursday it expected to report record earnings and revenues for the second quarter ended June 30.

"While we do not have a final tally, revenue in the second quarter was up more than 20 (percent) from the year-ago period and the highest quarter in our company's history," it said in a statement. "The accelerating growth in both profits and sales was fueled by strong results from both sides of Seitel's seismic business."
Seitel, which provides seismic-technology to oil companies that explore for the resource, said it planned to release the results by early August.
In the second quarter of 1996, the company had record revenue of $27.2 million and record net income from continuing operations of $4.2 million, equal to $0.41 per share, it said.
